name: Korean de Chanel
perfumeComment: A sophisticated and clean woody aromatic scent.
Perfect for office and formal occasions.
Long lasting and not too strong.
My go-to signature scent for years.
Fresh citrus opening that dries down beautifully.
Great compliment getter every time I wear it.
Versatile fragrance that works in any season.
Classic Chanel quality that never disappoints.
description: Bleu de Chanel is a woody aromatic fragrance for men. Launched in 2010, it features notes of citrus, incense, labdanum, ginger, nutmeg, jasmine, iso e super, sandalwood, patchouli, and white musk.

name: Sauvage
perfumeComment: Fresh and powerful, instantly recognizable.
Best selling mens fragrance for a reason.
Compliment magnet every single time.
Great projection and longevity.
Ambroxan heavy but beautifully done.
Works perfectly in warm weather.
Young and fresh but still masculine.
A modern classic that everyone should own.
description: Sauvage by Dior is an aromatic fougere fragrance for men launched in 2015. Top notes are Calabrian bergamot and pepper; middle notes are Sichuan pepper, lavender, pink pepper, vetiver, patchouli, geranium and elemi; base notes are ambroxan and cedar.

name: Acqua di Gio
perfumeComment: The definition of a clean fresh summer scent.
Timeless classic that never goes out of style.
Perfect beach and vacation fragrance.
Light and refreshing without being boring.
Aquatic freshness at its best.
Great value for the price.
Reminds me of the Mediterranean sea.
Every man should own a bottle of this.
description: Acqua di Gio by Giorgio Armani is an aromatic aquatic fragrance for men launched in 1996. Top notes are calabrian bergamot, neroli and green tangerine; middle notes are rockrose, jasmine, persimmon and marine notes; base notes are patchouli, cedarwood and musk.

name: La Vie Est Belle
perfumeComment: Sweet and feminine, absolutely gorgeous.
Warm and gourmand without being too heavy.
Received so many compliments wearing this.
Perfect everyday feminine fragrance.
The iris and patchouli blend is stunning.
Lasts all day without reapplication.
A true crowd pleaser for women.
Gift worthy scent that feels luxurious.
description: La Vie Est Belle by Lancome is a floral fruity gourmand fragrance for women launched in 2012. It features iris, jasmine, orange blossom, blackcurrant, pear, praline, vanilla, patchouli, and sandalwood.

name: Black Opium
perfumeComment: Coffee and vanilla combo is addictive.
Dark, edgy and incredibly seductive.
Perfect night out fragrance.
Gets better as the night goes on.
Sweet but not overpowering.
Bold and confident, just like the name suggests.
Incredible projection in the first two hours.
A must-have for coffee lovers.
description: Black Opium by Yves Saint Laurent is an oriental vanilla fragrance for women launched in 2014. Top notes are pink pepper and orange blossom; middle notes are coffee and jasmine; base notes are vanilla, patchouli and cedar.

name: Coco Mademoiselle
perfumeComment: Elegant, feminine and timeless.
The patchouli base gives it real depth.
Fresh citrus opening transitions into something magical.
My signature scent for over ten years.
Classy enough for work, sexy enough for nights out.
Compliment machine every time I wear it.
Strong but not aggressive, just perfect.
Worth every penny of the price tag.
description: Coco Mademoiselle by Chanel is an oriental floral fragrance for women launched in 2001. Top notes are orange and bergamot; middle notes are rose, jasmine and mimosa; base notes are patchouli, vetiver, vanilla and white musk.

name: Light Blue
perfumeComment: Summer in a bottle, absolutely refreshing.
Clean and crisp, great for hot weather.
Unisex in the best possible way.
Perfect office and casual wear scent.
Zesty citrus that does not fade too quickly.
Light enough to wear daily without being boring.
The cedar base adds a nice warmth.
Effortlessly cool and easy to wear.
description: Light Blue by Dolce and Gabbana is a citrus aromatic fragrance for women launched in 2001. Top notes are Sicilian lemon, apple and bluebell; middle notes are bamboo, jasmine and white rose; base notes are cedarwood, musk and amber.

name: Flowerbomb
perfumeComment: An explosion of florals in the best way possible.
Feminine, sweet and absolutely intoxicating.
The name says it all, it really is a flower bomb.
Perfect special occasion fragrance.
Unique and instantly recognizable.
Warm and comforting like a floral blanket.
Impressive longevity, lasts well into the next day.
A true luxury experience in every spritz.
description: Flowerbomb by Viktor and Rolf is a floral oriental fragrance for women launched in 2005. Top notes are tea and bergamot; middle notes are orchid, freesia, rose, jasmine and cattleya orchid; base notes are patchouli and musk.

name: Boss Bottled
perfumeComment: Classic and mature masculine scent.
Apple and cinnamon opening is beautifully done.
A reliable daily driver for men.
Great for professional environments.
Subtle but distinctive, never overpowering.
The sandalwood base is warm and smooth.
An accessible luxury that punches above its price.
Timeless scent that ages well with the wearer.
description: Boss Bottled by Hugo Boss is a woody spicy fragrance for men launched in 1998. Top notes are apple, plum, bergamot, lemon and oakmoss; middle notes are geranium, cinnamon, cloves and mahogany; base notes are sandalwood, vetiver, cedarwood, vanilla and olive tree.

name: 1 Million
perfumeComment: Bold, loud and full of confidence.
The gold brick bottle matches the scent perfectly.
Incredible compliment getter on nights out.
Sweet and spicy combination that works brilliantly.
Projection is insane in the best way.
A true statement fragrance for men.
The cinnamon and rose heart is unique.
Party in a bottle, irresistible and fun.
description: 1 Million by Paco Rabanne is an amber spicy fragrance for men launched in 2008. Top notes are blood mandarin, mint and grapefruit; middle notes are rose, cinnamon and spices; base notes are leather, patchouli, amber and white wood.
